### Strategic Evaluation Overview
Project SIH26034 (`PakkaLabel India`) implements a dual-purpose national infrastructure platform:
1. **B2G Field Enforcement Engine**: Equips Department of Consumer Affairs (DOCA) field inspectors with multimodal computer-vision scanning, deterministic statutory validation under Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011, and instant court-admissible Section 36 PDF notices (admissible under Section 65B of the Indian Evidence Act).
2. **B2B Enterprise Pre-Audit SaaS**: Enables FMCG brands (Nestlé, Britannia, ITC, Unilever) and Quick-Commerce marketplaces (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart) to pre-audit packaging artwork and marketplace digital listings before regulatory exposure.

## 3. PROACTIVE FEATURE EXPANSION & INNOVATION LOG

### 🌟 Innovation 1: Schedule II Principal Display Panel (PDP) Geometry Engine
- **Implementation:** [`backend/services/pdp_geometry.py`](file:///c:/Users/Mohammed%20Muzammil/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/Legal-Metrology-Compliance-Scanner/backend/services/pdp_geometry.py)
- **Statutory Value:** Directly addresses Rule 5 & Schedule II of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011. Calculates PDP surface area ($A_{\text{PDP}} = \text{Width} \times \text{Height}$) and maps to statutory minimum numeral heights:
  - $\le 50\text{ cm}^2 \rightarrow 1.0\text{ mm}$
  - $50 < A \le 100\text{ cm}^2 \rightarrow 1.5\text{ mm}$
  - $100 < A \le 500\text{ cm}^2 \rightarrow 2.5\text{ mm}$
  - $500 < A \le 2500\text{ cm}^2 \rightarrow 4.0\text{ mm}$
  - $> 2500\text{ cm}^2 \rightarrow 6.0\text{ mm}$
- **Commercial Impact:** Enables FMCG packaging design teams to pre-certify artwork font sizes before cylinder engraving, preventing multimillion-rupee product recall losses.

### 🌟 Innovation 2: Rule 6(1)(d) Manufacturing Date Statutory Engine
- **Implementation:** [`backend/services/rule_engine.py`](file:///c:/Users/Mohammed%20Muzammil/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/Legal-Metrology-Compliance-Scanner/backend/services/rule_engine.py)
- **Statutory Value:** Adds `audit_date_of_mfg(text)` parsing `(Mfg Date|Pkd Date|Packed On|Date of Mfg)` and statutory formats (`MM/YYYY`, `DD/MM/YYYY`).

### 🌟 Innovation 3: Dynamic Historical Inspection Registry & Section 36 PDF Exporters
- **Implementation:** [`backend/main.py`](file:///c:/Users/Mohammed%20Muzammil/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/Legal-Metrology-Compliance-Scanner/backend/main.py)
- **Routes Added:**

  - `GET /api/inspections/{id}/export-notice?notice_type=...`: Renders court-admissible Section 36 PDF improvement and compounding notices on demand.

### 🌟 Innovation 4: B2B Developer Portal Integration
- **Implementation:** [`frontend/src/App.jsx`](file:///c:/Users/Mohammed%20Muzammil/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/Legal-Metrology-Compliance-Scanner/frontend/src/App.jsx) & [`frontend/src/components/DeveloperPortal.jsx`](file:///c:/Users/Mohammed%20Muzammil/.gemini/antigravity-ide/scratch/Legal-Metrology-Compliance-Scanner/frontend/src/components/DeveloperPortal.jsx)

## 4. STATUTORY RULE ENGINE & PDF AUDIT

### Statutory Regex Evaluation Matrix

| Statutory Clause | Statutory Requirement | Regex / Engine Strategy | Validation Standard |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Rule 6(1)(a)** | Manufacturer / Packer Name & Postal PIN | `(?i)\b(mfg\.?\s*by\|manufactured\s*by\|packed\s*by...)\b` + `\b[1-9][0-9]{5}\b` | Pass if both present; Warning if PIN missing |
| **Rule 6(1)(b)** | Country of Origin | `(?i)\b(country\s*of\s*origin\|made\s*in\|product\s*of)\b` | Mandatory for domestic & imported goods |
| **Rule 6(1)(c)** | Net Quantity in Statutory SI Metric Units | `(?i)\b(net\s*(?:qty\|quantity)?)\s*[:.]?\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(g\|kg\|ml\|l\|n\|u)\b` | Rejects non-standard symbols (`gm`, `gms`, `ml.`) |
| **Rule 6(1)(d)** | Date of Manufacture / Packing | `DATE_MFG_RE` + `(MM/YYYY\|DD/MM/YYYY)` | Mandatory declaration of packaging timeline |
| **Rule 6(1)(e)** | Maximum Retail Price with Tax Declaration | `(?i)\b(incl\.?\s*of\s*all\s*taxes\|inclusive\s*of\s*all\s*taxes)\b` | Rejects standalone `MRP Rs. 50/-` |
| **Rule 6(1)(f)** | Consumer Grievance Contact / Care Cell | `(?i)\b(consumer\s*care\|customer\s*care\|helpline\|toll\s*free\|support@\|care@)\b` | Mandatory helpline or email |
| **Rule 6(11)** | Unit Sale Price (USP) Normalized Denominator | `(?i)\b(?:unit\s*sale\s*price\|usp)\s*[:.]?\s*(?:rs\.?\|₹)?\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:per\|/)\s*(g\|kg\|ml\|l)\b` | Validates math ($\text{USP} = \text{MRP}/\text{Qty}$) |
| **Rule 6(10)** | E-Commerce Marketplace Digital Listing | Digital Parser auditing all 5 core declarations on marketplace listing | Compounding fine: ₹25,000 per violation |
| **FSSAI Food Safety** | 14-Digit License + Veg/Non-Veg Indicator | `([12]\d{13})` + `(100%\s*veg\|vegetarian\|non-veg)` | Enforces Food Safety and Standards Act |

### Section 36 PDF Notice & Digital Signature Validation
- Generated via ReportLab Platypus.
- Embeds SHA-256 cryptographic image digest and salted tamper-evident seal.
- Features dynamic QR code linking to verification portal (`https://pakkalabel.india.gov.in/verify/{cert_no}`).
- Compliant with **Section 65B of the Indian Evidence Act, 1872** for court admissibility.
